_rules: Every number outside `settings` is either {value, source, verifiedOn} or a "[[OWNER: …]]" placeholder. scripts/check-energy-desk-config.mjs fails the build on a bare number. A feature whose inputs are still [[OWNER]] switches itself off and the report says so — no default is invented. See docs/energy-desk-architecture.md §10.

settings._note: Engineering and product switches, not facts. erpModuleLive turns on the calls to the ERP module (report storage, no-JS form); leave it false until the ERP deploy has been checked live.

meteringRegime.source: PSERC (Grid Interactive Rooftop Solar Photo Voltaic Systems) Regulations, 2021, reg 4.2(i), as amended by the Third Amendment Regulations, 2026 (Regu.203, notified 7 Apr 2026, in force 11 Apr 2026). Net billing, gross metering and behind-the-meter are also permitted; each consumer picks one.

netMeteringCapPct.source: PSERC rooftop regulations 2021, reg 4.2(i) as amended 2026: up to 100% of sanctioned load (kW) or contract demand (kVA × 0.9).

capBasis.value: AC inverter rating, against sanctioned load in kW or contract demand in kVA × 0.9
capBasis.source: PSERC rooftop regulations 2021, reg 4.2(i) as amended 2026.

kvaToKw.source: PSERC rooftop regulations 2021, reg 4.2(i) as amended 2026: contract demand is counted as kVA × 0.9.

netMeteringMaxKwp.source: PSERC rooftop regulations 2021, reg 4.2(i) as amended 2026: net metering is limited to 500 kWp. Above that a plant uses net billing, gross metering or behind-the-meter (reg 4.2(ii)–(v)).

feederLimitPct.source: PSERC rooftop regulations 2021, reg 5.1: total rooftop solar on one transformer or feeder may not exceed 80% of its rating — a network limit, not a per-consumer one.

yearEndSurplusPctOfFit.source: PSERC rooftop regulations 2021, reg 12.3 as amended 2026: credits left unadjusted at the end of the settlement year (1 Oct–30 Sep) are paid at 75% of the feed-in tariff within 30 days.

todIndustrialAboveKva.source: PSERC Tariff Order FY 2026-27 for PSPCL, Annexure I condition 15: time-of-day tariff applies to all industrial Large Supply (>100 kVA) and Medium Supply (>50–100 kVA) consumers. Under reg 12.3, ToD consumers net solar within each time block first.
